text:
julia: Quick design follow-up for API keys. Short list: 1) avoid accidental rotate, 2) make revoke consequences crystal, 3) show-secret a11y, 4) empty state copy. Fig link in thread.

rohan: Can we add a soft-confirm for Rotate? A tiny inline confirmation like 'Issue new key and keep scopes?' with Cancel/Confirm small buttons. That reduces misclicks.

aisha: Yes — rotate should be the safer default, but not a single-click that surprises users. Also add a helper under the scope pill: 'Rotation preserves scopes.' Users keep asking.

dan: Accessibility: the show-secret eye needs aria-label and a live announce. Use `aria-expanded` on the toggle and update an `aria-live="polite"` region with "Secret revealed" / "Secret hidden".

sam: Mobile: when the slide-over is full screen, ensure Copy is reachable above the soft keyboard; make copy button full-width on small screens.

julia: Revoke modal copy suggestion: 'Revoking this key will immediately stop services that use it. This action cannot be undone. This will be recorded in Audit logs.' Buttons: Cancel (neutral) and Revoke key (danger). Add link: 'Run dependency scan'.
ohan: small UX: when we show the one-time secret on rotate, microcopy should say: 'This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value.' Optionally expose 'Download .env' as a secondary action.

dan: Copy/Toast behavior: Copy button aria-label = 'Copy secret to clipboard'. Toast text 'Copied API key' with `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"`. Do not move focus to the toast.

aisha: Empty state decision: keep heading 'No API keys yet' and CTA 'Create your first key' (analytics favors 'create' for new users). Subcopy: 'API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely.' Include a tiny curl example to help devs try quickly.

sam: One more: do not offer undo for revoke. Legal prefers explicit revokes recorded in Audit logs. Instead, add an entry in recent audit activity with details and timestamp.

julia: Action items: I'll update Figma with soft-confirm and revised modal copy. rohan will prototype the inline confirm. dan will add aria-live and aria-expanded patterns. aisha will run copy by legal. sam will validate mobile safe-area for actions. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
